name.value: The One Sixty Wine Bar & Cafe

description.value: The One Sixty is a well-regarded wine bar and café in Port Moody's Murray Street area, voted Best Restaurant in Port Moody. It runs an ambitious wine program with over 20 pours by the glass and wines on tap, alongside a full food menu spanning brunch, lunch, and dinner. A touring cyclist arriving from the Shoreline Trail or Inlet trails would find a full sit-down meal, takeout options, and happy hour service available most days.

address.value: 3141 Murray Street, Port Moody, BC V3H 2R8

raw_osm.name: The One Sixty Wine Bar & Cafe

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business as an active, award-winning wine bar and café in Port Moody (not North Vancouver as listed in the OSM community field). Takeout is confirmed via a dedicated 'Delivery + Takeout' page and 'TO-GO MENUS' reference. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site; the only parking reference is to free street and underground car parking.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Port Moody, BC (confirmed by website address: 3141 Murray Street, Port Moody, V3H 2R8 and 'Voted Best Restaurant in Port Moody').

OSM email tag is hello@theonesixty.com; website footer on some pages shows info@theonesixty.com, though the contact page and OSM both use hello@theonesixty.com — minor inconsistency within the site itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant confirmed open with a current website listing upcoming events. No grounds for exclusion.
